---
name: tool-routing-mini
description: Select and use only host-admitted native tools for bounded medical-research work instead of treating code execution as a universal capability.
---

# Tool routing

1. Identify the smallest named tool that can produce the required structured
   evidence. Use code only in the isolated workspace when no named tool fits.
2. Read the tool schema and stage scope before calling it. Treat this skill as
   guidance, never as authority to use an unadmitted tool.
3. Preserve the returned artifact or evidence identifier and inspect failures
   before retrying with changed inputs.
4. Do not route a request to arbitrary files, URLs, credentials, shell escapes,
   or a real clinical system.
